top_signals.title: Odd Lots: CME’s Duffy on State of Finance Regulation (Podcast)
top_signals.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission was practically brand new when Terry Duffy started working at CME Group almost five decades ago, and over the course of his career at the exchange, this legend of the trading world has seen an enormous amount of change when it comes to finance regulation, including the rise of prediction markets, 24/7 trading and perpetual futures. Duffy is set to transition out of his current position as CEO next year, and this conversation, recorded live at City Winery

top_signals.title: Revolut hit with ‘service disruption’ as users unable to make payments
top_signals.summary: Revolut has been hit with a major outage leaving some customers unable to access their app and make payments with a physical card. The digital banking giant said on Tuesday morning it was experiencing “service disruption” across multiple features and was working to fix it.
